The '''Coruscant Police training academies''' were the academies located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that trained beings for service as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] (CSF). The CSF's training academies existed since the early days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. When the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] expanded its role from a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] detail to a full [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] and took charge of policing the [[Senate District/Legends|Legislative District]], it attracted many of the CSF's best police officers and academy recruits. The subsequent rivalry and power struggle between the CSF and the Senate Guard would last throughout the history of the Republic.<ref name="GalaxyWar" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Police training academies were first mentioned briefly in ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' which was published on [[September 15]], [[2009]] by [[Wizards of the Coast]].
